# m.stocks.filings.index

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

The index of SEC EDGAR filings by US-listed companies, one row per filing and filer.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.stocks.filings.index(symbols=None, *, form_type=None, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

- [Methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.APPEND`, which appends each row it hasn't seen, identified by `Cik` and `AccessionNumber`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows its rule under [shared arguments](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | Stock tickers; leave it out for every filer. `dm.ALL` is refused. |
| `form_type` | The SEC form type, such as `"10-K"`; leave it out for every form. |
| [`start`](README.md#start) | The first filing date. |
| [`end`](README.md#end) | The last filing date. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | Any of Massive's field names, such as `"form_type"`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. A watchlist's `fetch()` caps every request instead. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Further endpoint parameters, such as `{"cik": "0000320193"}`. Keys: `cik`, `cik_any_of`, `cik_gt`, `cik_gte`, `cik_lt`, `cik_lte`, `ticker_gt`, `ticker_gte`, `ticker_lt`, `ticker_lte`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | SEC EDGAR Index (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Stocks Basic | Updated daily |
| Stocks Starter | Updated daily |
| Stocks Developer | Updated daily |
| Stocks Advanced | Updated daily |
| Stocks Business | Updated daily |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The row's instrument, as Massive's ticker. From REST `ticker`: "Stock ticker symbol for the filing entity, if available." |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose symbol the library can't read. That row's `Symbol` is null. Null on every other row. When `MassiveConfig.unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, such a row fails the table instead, and the column is absent. |
| `AccessionNumber` | String | SEC accession number uniquely identifying the filing (e.g., '0000320193-24-000123'). |
| `Cik` | String | SEC Central Index Key (CIK) identifying the filing entity. |
| `FilingDate` | String | Date when the filing was submitted to the SEC (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `FilingUrl` | String | Direct URL to the filing on the SEC EDGAR website. |
| `FormType` | String | SEC form type (e.g., '10-K', '10-Q', '8-K', 'S-1', '4', etc.). |
| `IssuerName` | String | Name of the company or entity that submitted the filing. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. In a `poll()` table, it's the time of the poll the row's values came from. |
